During a [[Campaign against the Shadow Collective/Legends|campaign against the Shadow Collective]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] '''attacked''' the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] causing them to leave the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]]. At the same [[time]], the Separatists fought the Shadow Collective during a [[battle in the Nightbrother village]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], and an [[Attack on the Black Sun/Legends|attack on the Black Sun]].<ref name="Son of Dathomir 4" />
